answer: Require every newcomer to enter through a public atlas of vouched members: an established sponsor stakes a bond and lists the newcomer, and both lose the bond if the newcomer is later proven fake. The newcomer then completes a nebula of small, unrelated, checkable jobs - labelling images, fixing typos, checking facts - each audited by a different random reviewer, never twice by the same reviewer. A Sybil farmer must therefore pay a fresh bond, job series, and audit trail per fake account, while pigment-style fingerprinting of writing and timing links duplicates and burns the whole cluster.
